## Type

Client support request (how-to / access question).

## Request

* **Requested by:** Emily (WagerTech), 2026-09-30 10:47 AM ET, in the shared Slack channel.
* **Ask:** Whether Jumpr can give her a login to navigate Salesforce as the Brand Ambassador (BA) Andy, like the rep login she already uses to test rep views.
* **Slack (client):** https://jumpr-solutions.slack.com/archives/C0BBC05C2HG/p1790779673260759

## Internal notes

* An admin can view Salesforce as a BA with **Log in as** (Setup > Users > the BA's user record > Login). No separate login or extra license is needed. It needs Modify All Data and an active BA user record. It also needs "Administrators Can Log in as Any User" turned on, or login access granted by the user. It worked for Andy's user.
* Actions taken while logged in as a user are attributed to that user, so no data was edited.
* Emily does not get Log in as access (it needs Modify All Data). Taryn recorded a walkthrough of the BA view instead.
* Alternative if Emily wants to click around herself: a dedicated test BA user linked to Andy's BA record. This is not built. It adds a license and needs sign-off from Kobi first.
* **Loom (sent to Emily):** https://www.loom.com/share/45763cf682084fa4a904623e87aa4492
* **Related:** WAGR-501 (Show Brand Ambassador more prominently in the Ops list view). WAGR-393 (BA email/login provisioning) is still open.

## Next steps

- [x] Taryn: log in as Andy and record a walkthrough of the BA view.
- [x] Share the Loom with Emily in the Slack thread.
- [ ] Confirm the video answers Emily's need, or whether she wants a hands-on test BA login.
fields.summary: Support: Emily — view Salesforce as a Brand Ambassador (Andy)
